category_title: Senior primary boys with literacy underachievement and playground behavioral challenges
minimal_context: The tutor is directing the student to join a group of classmates for an outdoor game in the playground.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time to work with your classmates in groups for our outdoor game.

STUDENT: Do I have to be in a group with him? He is one of those kids that get on your nerves.

TUTOR: You need to stay with your group and participate in the planned task.

STUDENT: I don't want to play. I only like it when you can make mistakes and have no one laugh at you.

TUTOR: Just go over there and take your turn in the game.

STUDENT: (Kicks the game equipment away from the group) I'm not playing with them!

options.A: Terminate the demands for the outdoor game and remove the kicked game equipment for 10 seconds.
options.B: Put off the planned outdoor game and wait until the student picks up the kicked game equipment.
options.C: Prescribe using good manners, set out how to be a good winner and a good loser, and offer advice on how to greet peers.
options.D: Provide a visual chart with everyone's name and announce a game duration of 45 to 60 minutes.
